surfaces.reconciliation: Contract changes require a dedicated reviewed PR; no running loop edits its own active contract.
Each loop creates a unique immutable file with exclusive-create semantics; corrections are new linked receipts.
Daily may update its owned PR record; monthly resolves cross-PR conflicts, stale work, splits, and supersession.
Monthly governance publishes the canonical move; explicit human instructions may override it.
Legacy history is preserved but no longer receives mandatory scheduled appends; generated reports derive from immutable receipts.
Evidence events are immutable and cluster by underlying claim; source corrections create new events.
Raw belief events are immutable proposals with normalized scales and evidence provenance.
Monthly governance regenerates the consolidated view from immutable belief events.
Roundups are dated human-readable views; raw event files are canonical for machine reconciliation.
One accepted monthly synthesis governs queue-wide decisions for its period.
Weekly and daily emit proposals; monthly records acceptance, rejection, or deferral.
Monthly governance owns queue membership and ordering; daily may add scoped evidence without changing queue authority.
Completion requires accepted evidence and cross-queue ID validation.
Proposed quests cannot reuse IDs from any queue and do not become active without governance.
Blocked status preserves artifacts, blocker evidence, and a reactivation condition.
Only the active quest acceptance slice and its owning PR may mutate scientific implementation surfaces.
